Type: deco
Name: AmazonBasics 2-Pack Velvet Fleece Decorative Throw Pillows - 18" Square, Deep Teal
Colors: Deep Teal Velvet
Materials: Polyester
Set of 2 decorative 18 by 18 inches square throw pillows for sofas, lounge chairs, beds, and more 100% polyester velvet fleece is soft to the touch and durable Match to your existing decor or use as a contrasting accent piece; easy to care for by machine or hand washing Comes in a vacuum-sealed pack; allow 24 hours to decompress Made in a Green factory with an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards
